# Technical debt review

Once a quarter the team reviews the shortcuts taken in the code. Each item gets a short description, an estimate of the interest it charges every sprint and a proposal for repayment. The worst offenders are the modules everyone is afraid to touch, because every change there takes three times longer than it should.

We rank the list by cost of delay and agree on a fixed share of each sprint, around fifteen percent, for repayment. Nothing is repaid in one heroic push. The review also records the decisions we consciously accept, so that a shortcut becomes a visible choice instead of a hidden surprise.

The outcome is a short list on the wall, not a report.
